 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The most epic weekend of the 2026 college football season is here. Week 10 features seven matchups between teams in the first set of College Football Playoff rankings — and six of those games involve teams in the top 18.
 In the afternoon, No. 5 Alabama heads to Baton Rouge to play No. 14 LSU in another game with CFP implications. No. 6 Kentucky and No. 13 Tennessee will also try to stay in the mix in a Knoxville showdown.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement This weekend will go a long way toward shaping conference title pictures and the CFP field. Here are the games we'll be watching closely on Saturday:
 Final: No. 3 Utah 28, No. 9 BYU 20 
 Final: No. 7 Texas 34, No. 18 Missouri 20 
 Final: No. 8 UCLA 34, Minnesota 20 
 No. 5 Alabama at No. 14 LSU — LIVE (ABC) 
 No. 23 Oregon at No. 12 Ohio State — LIVE (CBS) 
 No. 6 Kentucky at No. 13 Tennessee — 6:15 p.m. ET (ESPN) 
 No. 2 Georgia at No. 10 Ole Miss — 7:30 p.m. ET (ABC) 
 No. 1 Miami at No. 11 Notre Dame — 7:30 p.m. ET (NBC) 
 No. 19 Iowa at Northwestern — 7:30 p.m. ET (Fox) 
 Oklahoma at No. 24 Florida — 7:45 p.m. ET (SEC Network) 
 Follow along below for highlights, analysis and more. 
 Live 88 updates Featured Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:45 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:57 PM UTC Alabama kicks FG
 A solid opening drive for the Tide ends in a 43-yard field goal.
 Alabama 3, LSU 0 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:54 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff OSU on the board first
 The Buckeyes are already in the end zone in their Big Ten clash with Oregon after an 11-play, 75-yard drive was capped off by a 16-yard Bo Jackson TD run.
 OSU 7, Oregon 0 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:51 PM UTC Alabama receives kickoff
 Keelon Russell and the Alabama offense will go to work first vs. LSU.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:49 PM UTC Final: UCLA 34, Minnesota 20
 UCLA is 9-0, its best start since 1998. These Bruins are for real.
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:47 PM UTC Bama-LSU on tap
 We're minutes away from kickoff in Tiger Stadium. Will the loser of this game be knocked out of playoff contention?
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:44 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Final: Texas 34, Missouri 20
 The Longhorns are headed home with the win, but the Tigers were a game opponent in this one. Mizzou fans will be smarting over the controversial Arch Manning fumble/incompletion call in the coming days, for sure.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:39 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Touchdown Texas
 Raleek Brown adds to his TD total on the day with a garbage-time TD to all but end this one.
 Texas 34, Missouri 20 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:35 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Turnover goes to Texas!
 The Tigers had what looked like a completion in the flat, but the wide receiver got drilled and the ball popped up right into the hands of Texas' Graceson Littleton to seal the game.
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:32 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Mizzou at midfield
 Meanwhile, the Tigers made a stop of their own to get the ball back. They have it at midfield with just under 2 minutes left in the game.
 Texas 27, Missouri 20 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:25 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff INTERCEPTION UTAH!
 BYU QB Bear Bachmeier launched it toward a wide receiver in the end zone, but he left it short and the Utes picked it off for the win!
 Utah's Nate Richie intercepted the ball to finish off the Cougars. That was the Utes' fourth interception of Bachmeier in the game.
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:25 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Mizzou punts it away
 The Tigers couldn't do anything with their possession and will need their defense to hold up in order to get the ball back.
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:24 PM UTC UCLA pads lead with another big TD throw
 For the second straight drive, the Bruins score on a 75-yard pass play to Aidan Mizell.
 UCLA 31, Minnesota 20 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:23 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff BYU gets ball back
 The Cougars' defense held strong and Utah was forced to punt the ball back to them with just under a minute left in the game.
 It was a poor punt too; BYU will start its drive at midfield with no timeouts left.
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:18 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Utah trying to milk clock out
 The Utes have the ball at their own 35-yard line with a fresh set of downs. We're under the 2-minute mark now.
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:15 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Touchdown Texas!
 The Longhorns have the lead late after Arch Manning hit Raleek Brown on a 24-yard wheel route to cap off a 6-play, 54-yard drive.
 Texas 27, Mizzou 20 | 5:03 left 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:12 PM UTC Coming up: Alabama at LSU
 This epic Saturday will continue with a massive SEC matchup in Baton Rouge. LSU coach Lane Kiffin brought out all the big alums for this one.
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:08 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Cayden Lee down for Mizzou
 The Texas defense has played really well since Montgomery's TD early in the second half and Missouri has to punt after a second-down sack.
 Tigers' star WR Cayden Lee is down after the third down play. It was unclear what happened to him as he was running upfield opposite the side of the run play.
 Lee was able to get up after the play after he was hit by Warren Roberson late. There was no flag.
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:06 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff INTERCEPTION BY UTAH!
 BYU ran a play-action pass near the goal line and Bear Bachmeier's pass was intercepted on a leaping grab by Utah's Trey Reynolds! The Cougars were at the 2-yard line and driving to tie the game before Reynolds' pick.
 What an interception by the linebacker!
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 07, 2026 08:05 PM UTC UCLA retakes lead right after Minnesota TD
 Wild sequence in Minneapolis. The Gophers tied it on a play-action pass near the goal line, but UCLA immediately responded with a go-ahead 75-yard TD toss from Ty Dieffenbach to Aidan Mizell.
 UCLA 24, Minnesota 17 | 4th quarter
